claim: The OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (version 1.0, 2026 edition, shown as a new project proposal in active development) names ten risks for agent skills: AST01 malicious skills, AST02 supply chain compromise, AST03 over-privileged skills, AST04 insecure metadata, AST05 untrusted external instructions, AST06 weak isolation, AST07 update drift, AST08 poor scanning, AST09 no governance, AST10 cross-platform reuse. The page gives a title, severity and key mitigation per item rather than a full description, so the Guardian's concrete checks per item are its own design, not OWASP text.

source.locator: summary table of AST01 to AST10
